# snipeit_hardware_audit_overdue (Data Source)

Lists assets that are overdue for audit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "snipeit_hardware_audit_overdue" "overdue" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `assets` (Attributes List) Matching assets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--assets))
- `total` (Number) Total number of matching assets.

<a id="nestedatt--assets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `assets`

Read-Only:

- `asset_tag` (String) Asset tag.
- `id` (Number) Asset id.
- `name` (String) Asset name.
